hypotheses.D1_canonicalization_is_exact_at_every_de: Every family output-4 space is preserved by tensor-Frobenius canonicalization within projector error 1e-5 at every tested layer.
hypotheses.D2_conditioning_enriches_low_rank_forms_: At every layer, at least three families have median canonical-axis top-four interaction energy above the 95th percentile of equally canonicalized random output-4 spaces.
hypotheses.D3_conditioned_axes_survive_two_nulls_at: At every layer, at least three families have at least three axes with empirical p at most 0.05 under both sign and coefficient-pairing nulls.
hypotheses.D4_strict_powerlaw_spikes_have_low_recal: At every layer, at most half of semantic canonical axes have positive leading excess above the fitted rank-33--512 power law.
hypotheses.D5_family_output_spaces_recur_across_dep: For each adjacent tested layer pair, mean same-family output-space overlap exceeds mean wrong-family overlap by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.D6_global_spikes_align_more_with_familie: Mean family overlap with the global top-four tensor output subspace is at least 0.05 larger at layer 17 than at layers 0, 3, and 8.
hypotheses.D7_late_global_concentration_implies_lat: Layer 17 has the largest global top-four tensor energy and the largest median family-conditioned top-four interaction energy.
hypotheses.D8_family_spaces_are_not_global_spike_sp: At every layer, median normalized overlap between family output-4 spaces and the global top-four tensor output space is below 0.25.
hypotheses.D9_layer3_replicates_prior_concentration: Every Layer-3 family median top-four energy is within 0.01 of the prior conditioned-spike result.
